title: Folder Organization Methodology
description: Add methodology configuration layer (PARA, Johnny Decimal, custom) so folder suggestions conform to user's preferred organizational system. Validate folder names against methodology rules. Builds on existing suggest-folder API and FolderSuggestions/FolderReorgModal components.

title: US-1: Folder methodology config types + Zustand store
description:
As a developer, I need a methodology configuration schema so the system knows how to constrain folder suggestions.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Create `/src/lib/folder-methodology.ts` with Zustand store
- [ ] `MethodologyPreset` type: `"flat" | "para" | "johnny-decimal" | "custom"`
- [ ] `"flat"` (default): no constraints, current behavior
- [ ] `"para"`: top-level must be Projects / Areas / Resources / Archive
- [ ] `"johnny-decimal"`: areas (10-19, 20-29...), categories (11, 12...)
- [ ] `"custom"`: user-defined list of allowed top-level folder names
- [ ] Persist to localStorage key `prompt-workbench-folder-methodology`
- [ ] Export `getMethodologyPromptContext()` returning LLM prompt fragment describing active methodology rules
- [ ] `npx tsc --noEmit` passes
- [ ] `pnpm build` passes

## Exit Condition
```bash
set -e
test -f src/lib/folder-methodology.ts
grep -q "MethodologyPreset" src/lib/folder-methodology.ts
grep -qE "flat|para|johnny-decimal|custom" src/lib/folder-methodology.ts
grep -q "getMethodologyPromptContext" src/lib/folder-methodology.ts
grep -q "prompt-workbench-folder-methodology" src/lib/folder-methodology.ts
npx tsc --noEmit
pnpm build
```

title: US-2: Inject methodology into suggestion API
description:
As a user, I want folder suggestions to follow my methodology so suggestions are consistent with my organizational system.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `POST /api/suggest-folder` accepts optional `methodology` field in request body
- [ ] When methodology provided, append methodology rules to Ollama prompt via `getMethodologyPromptContext()`
- [ ] PARA: instruct LLM to only suggest subfolders within Projects/Areas/Resources/Archive
- [ ] JD: instruct LLM to suggest folders matching XX or XX.XX numbering
- [ ] Custom: instruct LLM to only use provided top-level folder names
- [ ] `FolderSuggestions` component sends methodology config with API calls
- [ ] `FolderReorgModal` sends methodology config with API calls
- [ ] Flat methodology = no change to current prompt (backward compat)
- [ ] `npx tsc --noEmit` passes
- [ ] `pnpm build` passes

## Exit Condition
```bash
set -e
# API route accepts methodology in request type
grep -q "methodology" src/app/api/suggest-folder/route.ts
# Components import and send methodology
grep -q "useMethodologyStore\|folder-methodology" src/components/FolderSuggestions.tsx
grep -q "useMethodologyStore\|folder-methodology" src/components/FolderReorgModal.tsx
# Methodology prompt context is used in API
grep -q "getMethodologyPromptContext\|methodologyPrompt" src/app/api/suggest-folder/route.ts
npx tsc --noEmit
pnpm build
```

title: US-4: Folder name validation warnings
description:
As a user, I want warnings when folder names do not match my methodology so I keep my organization consistent.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Add `validateFolderName(name: string, config: MethodologyConfig): { valid: boolean; warning?: string }` to folder-methodology.ts
- [ ] PARA: warn if top-level folder is not Projects/Areas/Resources/Archive
- [ ] JD: warn if name does not match area (X0-X9) or category (XX) pattern
- [ ] Custom: warn if top-level name not in allowed list
- [ ] Show yellow warning badge in sidebar when folder name does not match methodology
- [ ] Validation runs on manual folder create/rename only (not on AI-created folders)
- [ ] `npx tsc --noEmit` passes
- [ ] `pnpm build` passes

## Exit Condition
```bash
set -e
grep -q "validateFolderName" src/lib/folder-methodology.ts
grep -qE "valid.*boolean|warning.*string" src/lib/folder-methodology.ts
# Sidebar shows validation warning
grep -qE "validateFolderName\|folder-methodology" src/components/Sidebar.tsx
npx tsc --noEmit
pnpm build
```
